svg.text: Ceiling sensor v2 - carrier PCB schematic
Generated from v2/hardware/source/layout.py. Pin names as printed on each module (the order in a box is not the physical order); items marked * must be checked against your boards (docs/verify.md).
Same-name labels are connected. n.c. = not connected. Radar 3V3 stays open: the LD2412 is fed from 5 V only (5 V or 3V3, never both). I2C pull-ups are on the modules.
